title: Flappy Bird, one shot
why: The classic zero-shot game test: game loop, collision, scoring and restart, with no follow-up turn to fix anything.
prompt: Write a complete, playable Flappy Bird clone as a single self-contained HTML file. Click or press space to flap. Include pipes with gaps, collision detection, a score counter and a restart on game over. Use only HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript with a canvas. Output only the file contents.
